reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low and I always forget pills at home. One sachet I can toss in my gym bag, already counted, is easier than a bottle. $24.99 for the first box is low enough to try once.
objection: It is still 2 capsules every day, and I forget things. If I skip days the box is just sitting there and I wasted money. Also I do not know this brand yet.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller dose in 1 capsule per sachet, or a 7-day trial pack so I can see if I actually keep up with it before paying for 30 days.
